description:
FILED s520 (Fable, 2026-10-18 10:4x) from the USER's free `/code-review ultra` run on s519a (clone review/ultra-s519a; the review session's probed record: briefs-and-rules-for-claude-subagents/s520/ultrareview-s519a.md; probe programs ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s513/review/ultrareview-s519a-probes/).  Fable RE-RAN every probe (perl 5.40.3 / the pre-batch base fca3593b = review/base-fca3593b / merged main 02a35add = review/wt-main29) and the three-way table below is Fable's own.  s519a is MERGED (MAIN-READY-29): this is ON MAIN.  None of the shapes occurs in the gate, the sweep or everyday (which is why they passed).  The s519a guard file Pl/t/local-term-01.t is where the guard rows go (inverse-verified on an fd04c048 extraction = the shape FAILS there).

R4 of the ultra review.  Pl/Parser2.pm `_split_void_local_list` (~7009-7015) joins the emitted statements with ' ' and `_hoist_local_term` (~7137) stops at `$pre->[-1]` and appends `$guard;`, dropping the whitespace (and its NEWLINES) before `if` / `unless`.  The `"\n" x ($line-1)` padding in `_replace_statement_by` does not help: nothing indexes the fragment's tokens, so they arrive in $doc without `_location` and PPI re-indexes from there to EOF against the SHORTENED text.  The drift is a running total over all such rewrites in a file.
  f4:  our %h; my $c = 1; sub foo { }
       foo(local $h{k} = 19)
         if $c;
       warn "here";                perl: here at F line 4.    base: line 4.    MAIN: line 3.
  Capture::Tiny's `$localize{stdout}++, local(*STDOUT)` NEWLINE `if ...;` (the pass's own cited shape, Parser2.pm:344 comment) is a real instance -- every die / warn below it in Capture/Tiny.pm reports the wrong line.
  FIX SHAPE: keep the replaced statement's newline count -- put the original inter-term whitespace (or at least its newlines) between the emitted statements and before the guard, so the rewritten text has the SAME number of lines as the original.  GUARD: a row in Pl/t/local-term-01.t that asserts `__LINE__` / a `warn` line number after a split AND after a hoist (perl oracle) -- and a second row with TWO rewrites above the warn (the running total).  Check the other in-place statement rewrites in Parser2 for the same loss (grep `_replace_statement_by` callers): one fix at the replacer if they all share it (rule 11).


Related: #3370 (the lowering), #3414 (the announce residue), #3415 (nested-key local on the wrong slot), #3361 (data point 4: these sat on main; the instrument that found them was the cloud review, not a leg).  The fix batch: briefs-and-rules-for-claude-subagents/s520/s520b-prompt.md.
